finalReading.passage: When young Ben could not explain why his plant grew faster near the window, he did not simply accept it. He moved the plant around, wrote down what he saw each day, and asked his teacher for help. A month later, he proudly told the class that sunlight was the answer he had been looking for.

questions.q: What did Ben do when he could not explain his plant's growth?
options: He moved the plant, recorded what he saw, and asked for help.
He gave up and threw the plant away.
He stopped thinking about it at once.
He told everyone it was magic.
